name: lmdeck-vscode
description: Use lmdeck's local models for Copilot chat and inline Fix when your Copilot quota runs out.

commands.title: Always use the local model for Fix and chat
Use the local model only when Copilot quota is exhausted
Choose model for Copilot inline chat (Fix)...

lmdeck.collectUserData.description: Opt-in: allow background processes to check Copilot quota state and share editor agent usage/state with lmdeck. Disabled by default.

lmdeck.autoCheck.description: Check the Copilot quota when VS Code starts and when its window regains focus (requires background user data collection to be opted in). When off, checks happen only through the lmdeck menu.

lmdeck.inlineModel.description: Model for Copilot inline chat (Fix). Empty = use lmdeck's configured default.

lmdeck.chatModel.description: Model for Copilot chat. Empty = use lmdeck's configured default.

lmdeck.focusCheckMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between automatic checks on window focus.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only changes user-level Copilot model defaults and talks to the local lmdeck server.
